newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CHEMINS DE FER UPS SURONGO STAKE.
newsitem.headline: CHEMINS DE FER UPS SURONGO STAKE.

text.p: Belgian holding company Entreprises et Chemins de Fer en Chine SA said on Tuesday it increased its holding in unit Surongo to 68.17 percent from 65.55 percent during the past year.
"The different purchases have the aim of reinforcing Surongo's stable shareholdership," Chemins de Fer said in a transparency statement published in Belgian newspapers.
The company said it bought 8,515 warrants on the stock exchange of which 7,355 had been exercised and changed into Surongo shares. A furter 4,218 shares were bought off bourse.
